events.title: Show HN: TinyAIArena watch AI agents battle it out
events.summary: Did you ever click on an “AI Arena” expecting glorious battle and instead get a boring benchmark? If so, this project is for you: proper life-or-death fights between four models on a picturesque 8×8 grid. May the most intelligent one win! Click on any of the matches to spectate them.
